input: Find STEM, science, coding, robotics, engineering, Lego and game design summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville STEM science coding robotics summer camp 2026
Asheville museum science summer camp 2026 AMOS
Asheville Bricks 4 Kidz summer camps 2025 Groce
Blue Ridge Summer Academy 2026 robotics engineering camps

candidates.name: Zaniac Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 STEM camps at Biltmore Park in South Asheville and UNC Asheville in North Asheville; coding, robotics, engineering and math.

candidates.name: Asheville Museum of Science
candidates.note: Downtown science camps for rising K–5; 2026 themes included natural science, computer programming and chemistry.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: SkillSet design/build camps and residential teen pre-college programs, including 2026 game design/AI and engineering/robotics.

candidates.name: Bricks 4 Kidz Asheville–Arden
candidates.note: LEGO engineering and motorized-building summer camps in East Asheville; also partners with YTL’s summer program.

candidates.name: YTL Training Programs
candidates.note: 2026 K–12 summer learning camps with STEM activities, agricultural enrichment and Zaniac/Bricks 4 Kidz partnerships.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 community-center day camps included science among broader activities; 2027 information scheduled for February 1.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery Camps explored wildlife, insects, streams, woodlands and other natural-science topics.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 outdoor garden camps for ages 6–10 and CITs 11–16; plants, animals, gardening and cooking.

candidates.name: National Inventors Hall of Fame
candidates.note: Camp Invention at Asheville Christian Academy for entering K–6, with grades 7–9 leadership spots; 2027 preregistration announced.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: 2026 COMPASS teen immersion programs included cybersecurity, herpetology and exercise science.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026 full-day STEAM camps for rising grades 1–3; themes included dinosaurs, fossils and insect science.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy at Henderson and Transylvania campuses offered hands-on STEM and career-exploration camps for school-age students.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension, Haywood County
candidates.note: 2026 4-H Summer Fun included electricity STEM camp for ages 11+, sewing, cooking, archery and evening crafts.

candidates.name: Pisgah Astronomical Research Institute
candidates.note: 2026 residential science camps covered astronomy, physics and astrobiology using research instruments and data.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: 2026 youth summer day camps; university youth offerings include science and robotics.

candidates.name: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics
candidates.note: Morganton hosts Early Accelerator day camps, residential Accelerator courses and the 2026 INSPIRE teen research program.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: 2026 Renaissance Child camps for grades 1–6 offered hands-on enrichment; university summer camps also included health sciences.
